Metadata.Goal: 让 TUI 与 CLI 通过同一 native component authoring workspace 安全写入 workflow resources。
Metadata.Description: 建立 runtime-bound store、authoring transitions 和跨 surface 统一写入 authority。

TaskSpace.name: establish-eidolon-workflow-authoring-workspace
TaskSpace.Description: Shared runtime-bound workflow authoring workspace and surface adapters.

TaskGroup.name: Authoring store and component binding
TaskGroup.Description: Define the explicit store contract, safe filesystem implementation and runtime-rooted component factory.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Containment tests reject absolute and traversal paths
Runtime and explicit factories produce the same component capability

Task.name: Add authoring store and workspace operations
Task.Description: Implement safe read/tree/search/diff/write/delete and atomic publish primitives behind an injectable store contract.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Store paths are containment-safe and writes use atomic replacement

Task.name: Bind workspace into WorkflowComponent
Task.Description: Add explicit and runtime-derived component factories with canonical loader and authoring workspace ports.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Runtime metadata workflow root selects the physical authoring root
Absent root uses a workDir-based conservative default and the binding is scoped to its runtime VM

TaskGroup.name: Shared publish commands and surface adoption
TaskGroup.Description: Move physical transitions into commands and make both surfaces call runtime-bound component instances.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Tool and CLI publish the same canonical files and evidence
CLI contains no workflow-specific filesystem write loop

Task.name: Add canonical publish and edit commands
Task.Description: Validate draft sources, atomically publish, revalidate and expose patch/edit through the same workspace.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Publish returns physical write and canonical revision evidence
Invalid replacement content is rejected before committed publication

Task.name: Adopt component authoring in model tools and CLI
Task.Description: Use runtime-bound component in tools and remove terminal-owned mkdir/write adapters.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: TUI/headless native tool writes beneath injected workspace root
CLI init uses the component transition and preserves dry-run behavior

TaskGroup.name: Cross-surface verification
TaskGroup.Description: Prove acceptance, containment, canonical proof and absence of private surface authority.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Focused package and terminal tests pass
Authority scans and package build pass

Task.name: Run authoring acceptance verification
Task.Description: Run tool/CLI/store tests, build entry points and scan for duplicated writes.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tool and CLI fixtures both produce loadable resources under their injected roots
No CLI-private workflow filesystem implementation remains
